contexts.text: Arrows, darts, etc., are the doctrinal things from which and with which they combat; especially those who are spiritual, and who on that account were formerly called Shooters with the bow.
Darts, shafts, or arrows = truth... That truths of doctrine, or rather doctrinal things, are called shafts, darts, and arrows, Illustrated.
A cleansed arrow () = truth of doctrine.
Arrows, darts, and shafts = the truths of doctrine that combat. Illustrated.
In the opposite sense, a bow = the doctrine of what is false fighting against truths and goods and destroying them, and the shafts and arrows, the falsities themselves thereof.
By the arrows that will be consumed upon them () is signified that they will be imbued with all evils and falsities.
